meta_title: OpenDrone owners map: where the boards fly
meta_description: Where OpenDrone owners are, by country and US state, as ranges, never exact counts.
title: OpenDrone owners
map_aria: Map of OpenDrone owners by country and US state. The same figures are listed as text.
map_failed: The map could not be loaded.
empty: The map fills in once the first orders ship.
pilot_signin_cta: Sign in to find pilots near you
pilot_not_owner: The pilot map is for people with a paid OpenDrone order. With one, sign in with the same account to join and to see where other owners are.
pilot_notice_linked: Discord linked. Now place yourself on the map.
pilot_notice_denied: Discord linking was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
pilot_notice_failed: Discord linking did not work. Nothing was saved, try again.
pilot_notice_unavailable: Discord linking is not available right now.
pilot_notice_owners_only: The pilot map is for signed-in owners.

pilot_step1_unavailable: Discord linking is not available yet.
pilot_step2_body: Tap the map where you fly, zoom in first. We keep only the centre of a grid cell of about 10 km, never the point you chose.
pilot_locate_failed: Could not read your location. Click the map instead.
pilot_consent_box: Show my Discord username and an area of about 10 km on the pilot map to signed-in OpenDrone owners only, until I withdraw or 24 months pass.
pilot_err_position: Choose a place on the map first.
pilot_err_not_owner: The pilot map is for owners with a paid order.
pilot_err_sign_in: Sign in again, your session ended.
pilot_err_generic: Could not save. Nothing changed, try again.
pilot_own_body: Shown as {name}, in an area of about 10 km in {place}. Consent given {date}.
pilot_withdrawn: You are off the map and your entry is deleted.
pilot_map_aria: Map of the pilots who chose to be listed, in areas of about 10 km. The same areas are listed below the map.
pilot_draft_open: Chosen: an area of about 10 km.
pilot_fact_shown: Shown: your Discord username and an area of about 10 km, never the exact point.
pilot_fact_to: To whom: signed-in OpenDrone owners only.
pilot_fact_withdraw: Withdraw: one button here deletes your entry at once. Details in the [privacy policy](/privacy).
pilot_submit_hint: To continue, choose a place on the map and tick both boxes.
note: Ranges per country and US state, refreshed monthly. [How we count](/privacy).
